Summary: EMBW-01: Initialize Vite + React 18 + TypeScript project
Description: Run: npm create vite@latest ember-web -- --template react-ts. Install and configure ESLint + Prettier. Add tsconfig paths alias (@/). Verify dev server starts and renders a blank page. Commit with package.json and tsconfig.json.

Summary: EMBW-02: Configure Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui base components
Description: Install tailwindcss + postcss + autoprefixer. Run shadcn/ui init (New York style, slate base color). Add Button, Input, Label, Card, Dialog, Badge, Separator. Verify Tailwind classes apply in App.tsx.

Summary: EMBW-03: Axios instance with JWT Bearer interceptor and error handler
Description: Create src/lib/api.ts with axios.create({ baseURL: VITE_API_URL }). Add request interceptor: reads token from Zustand store and injects 'Authorization: Bearer {token}'. Add response interceptor: on 401 clears auth store and redirects to /login. Export typed API helper functions.

Summary: EMBW-04: Zustand auth store with localStorage persistence
Description: Create src/store/authStore.ts using zustand + persist middleware (localStorage). Store: { token, userId, name, role }. Actions: setAuth(response), clearAuth(). Export useAuthStore hook. Verify token survives page refresh.

Summary: EMBW-05: React Router v6 with role-based protected routes
Description: Install react-router-dom v6. Define routes: /login (public), / (redirect based on role), /admin/* (ADMIN), /waiter/* (WAITER), /kitchen (KITCHEN). Create ProtectedRoute component that reads role from authStore and renders 403 fallback if unauthorized. Add NotFound page.

Summary: EMBW-06: Login page with React Hook Form + Zod validation
Description: Create /login route. Form: email (required, valid email) + password (required, min 6). On submit call POST /api/auth/login; on success call setAuth() and navigate based on role. Show toast on 401. Show field-level validation errors. Rate limit feedback (show 'Too many attempts' on 429).
Task
Epic Name: Create AppLayout component wrapping all authenticated routes. Sidebar links: ADMIN sees Catalog+Users, WAITER sees Tables+Sessions+Billing, KITCHEN sees KDS. Topbar shows user name + role badge + logout button. Collapse sidebar on mobile breakpoint.

Summary: EMBW-08: Dockerfile (Nginx) and production build config
Description: Create frontend/Dockerfile: node:20-alpine build stage (npm ci + npm run build); nginx:alpine serve stage copying dist/ to /usr/share/nginx/html. Add nginx.conf with try_files for SPA routing. Add EMBW_API_URL runtime env injection via entrypoint script. Add web service to docker-compose.yml (depends_on: app).

Summary: EMBW-09: Category list page with inline create/delete
Description: Route: /admin/categories. Fetch GET /api/catalog/categories (TanStack Query). Render table: name + action column. 'New Category' button opens create dialog (name field, POST /api/catalog/categories). Delete icon with confirmation popover (DELETE /api/catalog/categories/{id}). Show toast on success/error.

From category row, 'Edit' button opens Dialog with prefilled name field. On save: PUT /api/catalog/categories/{id}. Invalidate query on success. Handle 409 (duplicate name). Accessible with keyboard (trap focus in dialog).

Summary: EMBW-11: Menu items list with pagination and availability filter
Description: Route: /admin/menu-items. Fetch GET /api/catalog/items. Table columns: image thumbnail, name, category, price, availability badge. Filter by category (select) and availability (toggle). Clicking row navigates to /admin/menu-items/{id}.

Summary: EMBW-12: Menu item create form with image upload
Description: Route: /admin/menu-items/new. Form: name, price (number, min 0), category (select from GET /api/catalog/categories), optional image file input. Submit: POST /api/catalog/items multipart/form-data. Show upload progress bar. Redirect to list on success.

Summary: EMBW-13: Menu item edit form and availability toggle
Description: Route: /admin/menu-items/{id}. Prefill form from GET /api/catalog/items/{id}. Save: PUT /api/catalog/items/{id} multipart. Toggle availability: PATCH /api/catalog/items/{id}/availability (shows switch with optimistic UI update). Delete: DELETE with confirmation.

Summary: EMBW-14: Tables list with status chips and create modal
Description: Route: /admin/tables. Table: number, capacity, status chip (AVAILABLE=green, OCCUPIED=amber). 'New Table' button opens dialog (number, capacity). POST /api/catalog/tables on submit. Status chip doubles as waiter shortcut to PATCH /api/catalog/tables/{id}/status.

Edit icon opens dialog with prefilled number+capacity fields. PUT /api/catalog/tables/{id}. Delete icon with confirmation (only allowed when AVAILABLE). DELETE /api/catalog/tables/{id}. Refetch list on success.

Route: /admin/users. Fetch all users (GET /api/admin/users - needs new read endpoint or derive from existing). Table columns: name, email, role badge, created date. Clicking a row opens role assignment modal. Requires ADMIN guard.

From user row, open Dialog: current role shown + role select (CUSTOMER / WAITER / KITCHEN / ADMIN). Save calls PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/role. Show success toast with new role. Update row optimistically. Prevent ADMIN from demoting themselves.

Summary: EMBW-18: Floor plan — table grid with live status
Description: Route: /waiter/tables. Grid of table cards: number, capacity, status badge. Cards are clickable: AVAILABLE → open Create Session modal; OCCUPIED → navigate to active session. Poll GET /api/catalog/tables every 10s as fallback (WebSocket replaces polling in Sprint 6).

Triggered from AVAILABLE table card. Dialog: pre-filled table number (read-only), max participants input (min 1). POST /api/sessions on submit. On success navigate to /waiter/sessions/{id}. Handle 409 (already occupied).

From session detail, 'Show QR' button opens full-screen Dialog. Fetch GET /api/sessions/{id}/qr. Render QR code using qrcode.react library (value = qrToken string). Show session ID + table number below. 'Refresh Token' re-fetches. Downloadable as PNG.

Route: /waiter/sessions/{id}. Fetch GET /api/sessions/{id} (poll or WebSocket). Show: table info, status badge, participant list with avatars, ordered items table (name, participant, status chip, price). Sticky action bar: Show QR, Calculate Bill (when items DELIVERED), Close.

Summary: EMBW-22: Add and remove items from session (waiter override)
Description: From session detail, 'Add Item' opens a searchable menu item picker dialog. POST /api/sessions/{id}/items. Remove item: trash icon on PENDING/READY rows (not PREPARING). DELETE /api/sessions/{id}/items/{itemId}. Refetch session on success.

From session detail, 'Expand Capacity' button opens inline form (additional seats, min 1, max 100). PATCH /api/sessions/{id}/capacity. Show updated maxParticipants in header. Disabled when session is CLOSED.

Create src/hooks/useStompClient.ts. Connect to ws://{host}/ws with SockJS fallback. Inject JWT in CONNECT headers. Expose subscribe(topic, callback) and disconnect(). Auto-reconnect on drop (exponential backoff, max 5 attempts). Export connection status (CONNECTING/CONNECTED/DISCONNECTED).

Summary: EMBW-25: Subscribe to session topic for live updates
Description: In session detail page, subscribe to /topic/session/{id} using useStompClient. Handle: ITEM_ADDED → append item to list; ITEM_STATUS_UPDATED → update item chip; SESSION_CLOSED → show closed banner and disable actions. Unsubscribe on unmount.

In session detail, 'Calculate Bill' button enabled only when at least one item is DELIVERED and no existing bill. POST /api/billing/sessions/{id}/bill with splitMethod=BY_CONSUMPTION. On success navigate to /waiter/billing/{billId}.
Route: /waiter/billing/{billId}. Show: session ID, total amount, item breakdown table. Action buttons: Split by Consumption, Split Equally, (later) Register Payment.

'Split by Consumption' button: POST /api/billing/bills/{id}/split {splitMethod: BY_CONSUMPTION}. Renders per-participant card: name, items ordered, amount due, paid/unpaid badge. Trigger from bill summary page.

'Split Equally' button: opens dialog with participant count input (min 1, max = session.participants.length). POST /api/billing/bills/{id}/split {splitMethod: EQUAL_PARTS, participantCount}. Renders equal-share cards.

Summary: EMBW-30: Register physical payment per participant
Description: For each unpaid split card, 'Paid (Cash)' button opens confirmation popover: amount pre-filled from split.amount (read-only — enforces exact match). POST /api/billing/payments/physical. Mark card as PAID on success. Show 'All Paid' banner when all splits paid.

'Pay Digitally' button: POST /api/billing/payments/digital. Shows PENDING badge with gatewayRef. 'Confirm' button: POST /api/billing/payments/{id}/confirm. Marks split PAID. Fires session-close event when all paid.

Summary: EMBW-32: Session closed redirect and table release UI
Description: On SESSION_CLOSED WebSocket event (or after final payment), show success modal ('Table closed, seat released'). Navigate back to floor plan after 3s. Table card updates to AVAILABLE status automatically.

Summary: EMBW-33: KDS full-screen layout with kanban columns
Description: Route: /kitchen. Full-screen layout with four columns: PENDING, PREPARING, READY, DELIVERED. Each column is a scrollable list of order cards. Dark theme optimized for kitchen screens. Auto-refresh via WebSocket (no polling).

KDS card shows: table number, session ID (short), item name, participant name, time since ordered (live clock). Color-coded border by status. Cards in READY column flash amber if older than 5 minutes.

Each KDS card has a forward arrow button: PENDING→PREPARING, PREPARING→READY, READY→DELIVERED. Calls PATCH /api/kitchen/orders/{orderId}/items/{itemId}/status. Card moves to next column with slide animation on success.

Subscribe to /topic/kitchen using useStompClient. Handle ITEM_ADDED: insert new card in PENDING column. Handle ITEM_STATUS_UPDATED: move card between columns. Handle SESSION_CLOSED: remove all cards for that session. On reconnect: re-fetch GET /api/kitchen/display to sync.

Play a short audio chime (Web Audio API, no external lib) when ITEM_ADDED WebSocket event is received. Mute button in KDS topbar persists setting in localStorage. No alert if window is already focused on KDS and sound is off.

Summary: EMBW-38: Subscribe to /topic/session/{id} for live waiter session updates
Description: Re-verify the waiter session detail subscription (EMBW-25) works end-to-end against the real backend. Test: customer adds item → card appears in waiter view < 1s. Test: kitchen marks READY → chip updates live. Acceptance test documented.

Install react-hot-toast. Wire success/error toasts to all mutation callbacks (create, update, delete, pay). Global Toaster placed in AppLayout. Toasts auto-dismiss after 4s, max 3 visible at once. Accessible: aria-live region.

Summary: EMBW-40: Error boundaries and fallback UI
Description: Wrap each major page in ErrorBoundary (React 18 class component). Fallback shows: error message + 'Try again' button that resets boundary. Add global unhandled promise rejection handler that fires toast. Add empty-state illustrations for no data cases (no tables, no items, etc.).

Create Skeleton wrapper component (animated shimmer using Tailwind). Apply to: table list, menu item list, session detail, KDS board (skeleton cards). Skeletons shown on initial fetch; spinners shown on refetch (TanStack Query isFetching).

Summary: EMBW-42: Responsive layout (tablet-first for POS + KDS)
Description: Verify all pages on 768px, 1024px, 1280px viewports. Floor plan grid: 2 cols on tablet, 3-4 on desktop. KDS: 4 columns scroll horizontally on <1280px. Session detail: side-by-side on >1024px, stacked on tablet. Sidebar collapses to icon-only on <1024px.

Summary: EMBW-43: X-Trace-Id request ID display in error toasts
Description: Extract X-Trace-Id from error responses in the Axios response interceptor. Include trace ID in error toast message ('Error ID: abc123') so staff can report issues. Log full error to console in dev mode.

Summary: EMBW-44: Unit tests — auth store and HTTP interceptors
Description: Vitest + @testing-library/react. Test authStore: setAuth persists token; clearAuth removes token; role is read correctly. Test Axios interceptor: token is injected in request headers; 401 response triggers clearAuth and navigation. Use msw for HTTP mocking.

Summary: EMBW-45: Component tests — Login page and critical UI
Description: @testing-library/react tests: Login renders form; submit with empty fields shows validation errors; successful submit redirects based on role; 401 shows error toast. Test SessionDetail: items render; QR button opens modal. Test KDS card: forward button updates status.

Summary: EMBW-46: Playwright E2E — waiter full flow
Description: Playwright test: boot local Docker stack; login as WAITER; create session; confirm QR modal opens; login as CUSTOMER (2nd browser context) → join session → add item; switch back to waiter → verify item appears; calculate bill → pay → session closed. Run in CI headless.
Login as KITCHEN; verify KDS loads and shows pending items from waiter E2E fixture; click PREPARING → READY → DELIVERED; verify card moves columns. Assert no cards remain after DELIVERED.

Summary: EMBW-48: GitHub Actions CI for web
Description: Add .github/workflows/web-ci.yml: install deps (pnpm); run lint (ESLint); run unit + component tests (vitest); run Playwright E2E against docker-compose stack. Run on PR to main. Cache node_modules and playwright browsers.

Summary: EMBW-49: Dockerfile multi-stage and Nginx config for web
Description: Dockerfile: node:20-alpine build (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile + vite build); nginx:alpine serve (copy dist, custom nginx.conf with try_files $uri /index.html). Runtime env: inject VITE_API_URL via /docker-entrypoint.d/ shell script replacing __API_URL__ placeholder. Verify with docker build + docker run.

Add ember-web service to root docker-compose.yml: build: ./frontend; ports: 5173:80; environment: VITE_API_URL; depends_on: app. Update README with startup instructions. Test full stack with docker compose up.

Summary: EMBM-01: Initialize Expo SDK 51 + TypeScript project
Description: npx create-expo-app@latest ember-mobile --template expo-template-blank-typescript. Configure app.config.ts (name, slug, icon, splash). Install @types/react. Add .env support with expo-constants. Verify Expo Go runs on iOS simulator and Android emulator. Commit.

Summary: EMBM-02: React Navigation v6 — stack and tab navigators
Description: Install @react-navigation/native, @react-navigation/stack, @react-navigation/bottom-tabs + react-native-screens + react-native-safe-area-context. Create RootNavigator: AuthStack (Login, Register) | AppTabNavigator (Menu, Scan, Orders, Bill). Initial route based on auth state. Typed route params.

Summary: EMBM-03: Axios instance with JWT Bearer interceptor
Description: Create src/lib/api.ts with axios.create({ baseURL: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL }). Request interceptor: reads token from authStore and injects Authorization header. Response interceptor: 401 → clear store → navigate to Login. Export typed resource clients (authApi, sessionApi, catalogApi, billingApi).

Summary: EMBM-04: Zustand auth store with expo-secure-store persistence
Description: Create src/store/authStore.ts with zustand. Fields: token, userId, name, role. Persist token in expo-secure-store (encrypt at rest). On app launch: read token from SecureStore, restore auth state. Actions: setAuth, clearAuth. Test: survives app restart.

LoginScreen: email + password TextInput fields using React Hook Form + Zod. Calls POST /api/auth/login via authApi. On success: calls setAuth() + navigates to AppTabNavigator. On 401: shows 'Invalid credentials' error. On 429: shows 'Too many attempts, wait 1 minute'. Keyboard-aware ScrollView.

RegisterScreen: name, email, password fields (same validation as Login + name min 2 chars). Calls POST /api/auth/register. On success: calls setAuth() and navigates to Menu tab. Show server error messages inline. 'Already have an account?' link navigates to Login.

Summary: EMBM-07: NativeWind setup + base design tokens
Description: Install nativewind@4 + tailwindcss. Configure tailwind.config.js with content glob for .tsx files. Define custom colors matching Ember brand (ember-orange, ember-dark). Create src/components/ui/Text.tsx and Button.tsx using NativeWind. Apply to Login + Register screens.
Task
Epic Name: Design app icon (1024x1024 PNG, Ember flame logo) and splash screen (centered logo on dark background). Configure in app.config.ts: icon, splash.image, scheme for deep links. Set statusBarStyle: light. Add android.adaptiveIcon. Verify on physical device via Expo Go.

Summary: EMBM-09: Category horizontal scroll tab bar
Description: MenuScreen header: horizontally scrollable category chips. Fetch GET /api/catalog/categories (TanStack Query, staleTime 5min). 'All' chip selects no filter. Tapping a category scrolls menu FlatList to first item of that category. Highlight selected chip.

Summary: EMBM-10: Menu items FlatList with category filter
Description: Render GET /api/catalog/items with FlatList (2-column grid). Each card: image (expo-image with blurhash placeholder), name, price, availability badge. Filter by selected category (client-side). Pull-to-refresh calls query.refetch(). Show empty state when no items match filter.

Summary: EMBM-11: MenuItem card component with image
Description: MenuItemCard: rounded card with image (expo-image), name (semibold), price formatted as currency, category chip. Unavailable items show semi-transparent overlay + 'Unavailable' label. Tap navigates to detail. Accessible: role='button' with item name as label.

Tap card → open @gorhom/bottom-sheet at 60% height. Shows: full image, name, category, description (if available), price, availability status. CTA: 'Add to Order' button (enabled only if user is in an active session AND item is available). Disabled state with tooltip when no active session.

Summary: EMBM-13: Search bar with debounce filter
Description: SearchBar component at top of MenuScreen. Debounce 300ms using useDebounce hook. Filters items client-side by name (case-insensitive). Clears category chip selection when typing. Show 'No results for X' empty state. Clear icon resets search.

Summary: EMBM-14: TanStack Query cache for offline stale menu
Description: Configure QueryClient: staleTime=5min, gcTime=30min for catalog queries. Use useQuery with networkMode='offlineFirst' for menu items and categories. Show 'You're offline – showing cached menu' banner when NetInfo.isConnected is false. Disable Add to Order when offline.

Summary: EMBM-15: QR scan screen with expo-camera
Description: ScanScreen: request camera permission on mount (expo-camera). Show camera preview full-screen. Use BarCodeScanner to detect QR codes. On scan: extract qrToken from QR data, vibrate (Haptics.impactAsync), and navigate to JoinSessionScreen passing { qrToken, sessionId }. Show torch toggle button.

Summary: EMBM-16: Join session flow with display name input
Description: JoinSessionScreen: TextInput for display name (max 50 chars, matching @Size(max=50) backend constraint). Pre-fill with user's registered name. 'Join Table' CTA: POST /api/sessions/{id}/join with { qrToken, userName }. On success: save activeSessionId to sessionStore + navigate to SessionTab. Handle 409 (already joined, full).

When user has activeSessionId: Session tab shows SessionHomeScreen. Sections: table header (number + status), participants row (avatars with names), 'My Orders' count badge. 'Add Items' button navigates to Menu tab. Fetch GET /api/sessions/{id} (WebSocket-driven after Sprint 6).

ParticipantList: horizontal scroll of avatar circles (first letter of name, background color derived from name hash). Show participant count vs maxParticipants (e.g. '3 / 4 seats'). Tooltip/sheet on tap shows full name.

Summary: EMBM-19: Leave session and error handling
Description: 'Leave Session' option in session header menu. Shows confirmation alert. On confirm: clear sessionStore.activeSessionId + navigate to Scan tab. Handle expired/invalid QR token (IAE from backend) with user-friendly alert: 'This QR code has expired, ask your waiter for a new one'.

'Add to Order' in MenuItem detail bottom sheet: POST /api/sessions/{activeSessionId}/items { menuItemId }. On success: close sheet + show brief 'Added!' snackbar + increment Orders tab badge. Handle errors: 'Session closed', 'Item unavailable', 'Not a participant'.

Summary: EMBM-21: My orders tab with status chips
Description: OrdersScreen 'Mine' tab: list own OrderItems filtered by authentication.getName(). Each row: item name, price, status chip (PENDING=gray, PREPARING=amber, READY=green, DELIVERED=blue). Sorted by addedAt desc. Show empty state: 'You haven't ordered anything yet'.

Summary: EMBM-22: All orders tab grouped by participant
Description: OrdersScreen 'All' tab: items grouped by participantName (SectionList). Section header: participant name + avatar + subtotal. Each row: item name + status chip. Useful for seeing the table's full order. Show participant order count in section header badge.

Swipe left on own PENDING item in 'Mine' tab reveals 'Remove' action (red background). DELETE /api/sessions/{id}/items/{itemId}. Confirm with haptic feedback. Disabled (no swipe) for PREPARING/READY/DELIVERED items — show tooltip: 'Item already being prepared'.

When item status changes: animate chip background color with react-native Animated API (fade transition 300ms). READY items show a subtle pulsing ring animation to draw attention. DELIVERED items show a checkmark icon. Status label accessible via accessibilityLabel.

Summary: EMBM-25: Real-time order status via WebSocket
Description: Subscribe to /topic/session/{activeSessionId} on SessionHomeScreen mount. Handle ITEM_ADDED: append to order list (vibrate if not own item). Handle ITEM_STATUS_UPDATED: update chip in-place with animation. Handle SESSION_CLOSED: show 'Your session has ended' banner. Unsubscribe on unmount.

Summary: EMBM-26: Bill tab appears when bill is ready
Description: BillScreen: initially shows 'Waiting for bill...' placeholder. When SESSION_CLOSED or bill detected via polling GET /api/sessions/{id}: show bill content. Alternatively, waiter triggers and client receives WebSocket event. Fetch GET /api/billing/sessions/{id}/bill (once bill exists).

BillScreen shows: my items (filtered by participantName matching userName), my subtotal, total bill amount. If split exists: show my BillSplit amount due prominently. 'Pay Now' CTA enabled when BillSplit is unpaid.

'Pay Now' button: POST /api/billing/payments/digital { billId, participantName, amount: split.amount }. Amount is read-only from the split (backend enforces exact match). Navigate to PaymentPendingScreen.

PaymentPendingScreen: shows order reference (gatewayRef), amount, instructions. 'Back' disabled. Poll GET /api/billing/payments (or wait for WebSocket SESSION_CLOSED event). In Sprint 6: auto-advance on confirmation event. For now: 'Already Paid? Confirm' CTA.

PaymentConfirmedScreen: green checkmark animation (react-native-reanimated). Shows amount paid + timestamp. 'View Receipt' scrollable breakdown. 'Done' clears activeSessionId + navigates to Menu tab. Accessible: announce 'Payment successful' via AccessibilityInfo.

After session closes: show summary of all items ordered by current user, total amount, date/time. Shareable as image (react-native-view-shot → Share sheet). 'Rate your experience' placeholder (future). Tap 'Scan New Table' navigates to Scan tab.

Create src/hooks/useSessionSocket.ts. Connect using @stomp/stompjs over SockJS. Inject JWT in CONNECT headers from authStore. Takes sessionId param. Returns subscribe helper and connectionState. Auto-reconnect with jitter backoff. Disconnect on component unmount. Works in background (AppState listener keeps alive).

In OrdersScreen and SessionHomeScreen: subscribe to /topic/session/{id}. Handle ITEM_STATUS_UPDATED: update item in TanStack Query cache in-place. Trigger status animation (EMBM-24). Haptic feedback on READY (Haptics.notificationAsync SUCCESS). Log event to console in dev.

On SESSION_CLOSED event: clear activeSessionId from sessionStore. Show modal: 'Your session is complete. Thank you!' with receipt summary. Navigate to PaymentConfirmedScreen or BillScreen. Disable Add-to-Order and Remove buttons retroactively.

Summary: EMBM-35: expo-notifications setup and push token registration
Description: Install expo-notifications. On auth success: request notification permissions (requestPermissionsAsync). Get Expo push token. Send token to backend (POST /api/users/push-token — new endpoint to add). Store token in SecureStore. Handle foreground notifications with custom alert.

Summary: EMBM-36: Push notification — order is ready
Description: When ITEM_STATUS_UPDATED event received with status=READY: if app is backgrounded (AppState.currentState !== 'active'), show local push notification via expo-notifications: 'Your [itemName] is ready! 🍽️'. On tap: open app + navigate to OrdersScreen. Group notifications by session.

Summary: EMBM-37: In-app notification dot on Orders tab
Description: Track unread status events in a local counter (Zustand). Increment when ITEM_STATUS_UPDATED received. Show red dot badge on Orders tab icon. Clear badge when user navigates to OrdersScreen. Persist count across tab switches but reset on session end.
Handle SESSION_CLOSED WebSocket event when app is backgrounded: fire local push notification: 'Your bill is ready. Tap to review.' On tap: open BillScreen. Requires EMBM-35 completed.
Task
Epic Name: Jest tests: authStore setAuth/clearAuth with SecureStore mock; sessionStore activeSessionId lifecycle; useDebounce hook timing; orderStatusColor() function (maps status to correct color token); QR parse utility. Aim for 80% coverage on utility modules.

Description: Task
Epic Name: @testing-library/react-native tests: LoginScreen shows errors on empty submit; successful login calls setAuth and navigates; MenuItemCard renders unavailable overlay; OrderItem swipe-delete calls API; status chip updates color on status prop change. Mock Axios with msw.

Summary: EMBM-41: Maestro E2E — login → scan QR → order → pay
Description: Maestro flow file: launch app; login as customer; tap Scan tab; (inject pre-seeded QR token via deeplink); enter display name → join session; navigate to Menu → add one item; navigate to Orders → verify item shows PENDING; navigate to Bill (simulate waiter bill event); tap Pay → confirm. Run on iOS sim + Android emu in CI.

Create eas.json with development (simulator), preview (internal distribution), production (store) profiles. Configure app.config.ts with correct bundleIdentifier (com.vanter.ember) and package (com.vanter.ember). Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL per environment. Add .easignore.

eas build --platform ios --profile preview. Enroll Apple Developer account. Configure signing (managed credentials). Submit to TestFlight: eas submit --platform ios. Invite internal testers. Fix any provisioning or entitlement errors.

eas build --platform android --profile preview. Configure google-services.json for FCM (required by expo-notifications on Android). eas submit --platform android to Google Play internal track. Verify on physical Android device.

Install @sentry/react-native + expo-sentry. Initialize in App.tsx with DSN from env. Capture unhandled exceptions and promise rejections. Add Sentry.captureException in Axios error interceptor. Wrap app with Sentry.wrap(). Test by triggering a known error in dev build.

Summary: EMBM-46: Performance profiling and bundle optimization
Description: Enable Hermes engine (default in Expo 51). Use React DevTools profiler to identify re-render hotspots. Memo-ize MenuItemCard and OrderItem with React.memo. Lazy-load BillScreen and ScanScreen using React.lazy equivalent (loadable). Check bundle size with expo-bundle-analyzer. Target FlatList render under 16ms per frame.

Summary: EMBM-47: App store metadata and screenshots
Description: Write App Store and Google Play descriptions (English). Create 5 App Store screenshots (6.7-inch iPhone): Menu, Scan QR, Active Order, Bill, Payment. Create 3 Google Play screenshots. Design feature graphic (1024x500). Prepare privacy policy URL (required for permissions: camera, notifications).

Summary: EMBM-48: GitHub Actions CI for mobile
Description: Add .github/workflows/mobile-ci.yml: install deps (npm ci); run Jest unit + component tests; run Maestro E2E on iOS simulator (macos-latest runner). On main branch: trigger EAS build --profile preview for both platforms. Cache expo CLI and node_modules.
